latest_news.headline: Israel strikes Hezbollah targets and says Lebanon presence will continue
latest_news.text: Reuters, BBC, Al Jazeera, NBC News and Jerusalem Post reported Beirut/southern-suburb strikes and conditional stand-down language.

latest_news.headline: Russia launches widespread strikes; Ukraine hits oil/chemical facilities
latest_news.text: Devdiscourse, MSN, Saudi Gazette and regional feeds reported Russian missile/drone attacks, Kyiv-area damage and Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil, chemical, base and drone-facility targets.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan airstrikes and border attacks intensify
latest_news.text: Business Standard, DD News, MSN and News18 reported Pakistani airstrikes killing at least 13 in Afghanistan and a TTP-claimed missile strike killing Pakistani police.

latest_news.headline: Russia frames Belarus nuclear weapons as NATO deterrent
latest_news.text: Eastern Herald feeds reported Moscow/Lavrov framing nuclear weapons in Belarus as a formal deterrent against NATO and Ukraine.

latest_news.headline: DPRK says denuclearisation is irreversibly terminated
